serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Nothing stable really… If I need money I just go to the labor office and work wherever they tell me to.
Big Daddy: That’s horrible, I heard many bad things about these jobs.
You: Yeah, payment is also terrible, but with no higher education I can’t find anything better.
Big Daddy: That’s sad to hear. 
Big Daddy: I wish I could help you, but my businesses seem a little too upper middle class for someone like you to be employed in them. No offense.
…
You: Sure… None taken…
